headline: Indian IT services showed mixed revenue growth with AI driving outsized gains for a few firms while the sector‑wide outlook softened.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from sub‑2% at Infosys to over 50% at Coforge. AI‑related revenue and deal wins were highlighted by several companies, boosting margins at HCLTech and Mphasis. Guidance was trimmed at Infosys and introduced at HCLTech and Wipro, indicating caution. Profit trends were mixed, with strong jumps at HCLTech and OFSS but a decline at Wipro.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: AI contributed 10%+ of total revenue at TCS and drove double‑digit profit growth at HCLTech and Mphasis.

themes.title: Guidance tightening
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2% and HCLTech introduced a modest 2.5‑4% range.

themes.title: Margin pressure
themes.detail: Operating margins slipped at Infosys (21%) and Wipro (16.5%) while Coforge lifted its EBIT margin guidance to 16%.

leaders.why: Revenue grew 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance was raised to 16%.
Revenue up 11.5% YoY, AI revenue $219 m, profit jumped 21%.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and FY27 guidance was cut.
Revenue grew 9.1% YoY but profit fell 1.9% and headcount fell sharply.
